answer_text: Starting in the financial year 2028–2029, all new products manufactured from non-ferrous metals must contain a minimum of 5% recycled content. This legally binding requirement scales progressively so that by FY2031– 2032, manufactured products must contain at least 10% recycled aluminium, 20% recycled copper, and 25% recycled zinc. By forcing manufacturers to permanently integrate secondary scrap into their production supply chains, this Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) framework secures a captive, guaranteed demand pipeline for organized recyclers.
